MARK2 is highly chemically tractable (potent_measured_ligand, approved_drug_tractable, strong structure) yet carries a highly_constrained_safety_concern (gnomad highly_constrained, lethal_ko, germline_pathogenic, broad normal expression) — tractability does not resolve the missing therapeutic window.

Amplified/overexpressed-dependent strata suggest a possible responder subset, but copy-number-distribution=broadly_neutral means that stratum is not materially present in PAAD, weakening any biomarker-selected population claim.

causal_rationale.statement: MARK2 sits in a well-characterized signaling network in PAAD (signaling-network-mechanism well_characterized) with active phosphorylation and relatively high pathway activity (phospho-pathway-activity phospho_present; pathway-activity-context relatively_high), and its high expression associates with worse survival in an oncogenic-frequently-altered context (expression-clinical-association expression_high_worse_survival; oncogenic-pathway-alteration frequently_altered) — but this active-pathway context does NOT convert into a monotherapy dependency: CRISPR and RNAI concordantly call MARK2 non_dependent (crispr-rnai-dependency-concordance moderately_concordant_non_dependent; pan-cancer-crispr-dependency-distribution non_dependent; pan-cancer-rnai-dependency-distribution non_dependent), mechanistically because paralog buffering is strong (paralog-buffering strong). A synthetic-lethal / combinatorial signal exists (combinatorial-dependency strong_synthetic_lethal; synthetic-lethal-partners has_experimental_sl_partner) BUT it cannot be operationalized because no actionable partner is mapped in PAAD (partner-conditional-dependency no_partner_mapped) and there is no monotherapy dependency floor to build on (non_dependent by both screens); the actionable causal case is therefore largely hollow.

therapeutic_hypothesis.statement: A small-molecule inhibitor of MARK2 is chemically feasible — MARK2 is chemically active with a potent measured ligand, approved-drug-class tractability, and a strong static structure (tractability_sm chemically_active; measured-potency-tractability potent_measured_ligand; known-drug-tractability approved_drug_tractable; structure-features-static strong) — and small molecule is the correct modality because surface/antigen approaches are foreclosed (surface_modality neither_viable; protein-surface-evidence not_surface; surface-topology-and-ptm no_transmembrane; adc-tce-modality-fit neither_viable) and degradation is unfavorable (degradation-feasibility unfavorable_location). HOWEVER, chemical tractability does not create a usable drug: monotherapy dependency is absent (dependency non_dependent_paralog_buffered) so a single-agent inhibitor lacks a killing rationale, and a combination/SL strategy is UNSUPPORTED because no actionable partner is mapped in PAAD (partner-conditional-dependency no_partner_mapped) despite the experimental SL signal (combinatorial-dependency strong_synthetic_lethal).

population.statement: No credible biomarker-selected responder population is identifiable in PAAD. The only enriched-dependency signal comes from amplified/overexpressed strata (amp-expr-stratified-dependency amplified_overexpressed_moderately_dependent; copy-number-stratified-dependency amplified_moderately_dependent), but this stratum is not materially present because the MARK2 copy-number distribution is broadly neutral (copy-number-distribution broadly_neutral), so an amplification-selected population claim is unsupported. Expression is broad rather than tumor-restricted (expression tumor_broadly_expressed; tumor-rna-distribution-by-subtype pan_subtype_uniform), and no on-target compound or PRISM activity anchors a responder class (mutation-drug-response no_on_target_compound; prism-compound-activity no_compounds_found). Default population would be unselected PAAD, which the dependency data do not support.
population.subtype_or_biomarker: None credible; nominal amplified/overexpressed stratum not materially present (copy-number-distribution broadly_neutral)

therapeutic_window.statement: There is no therapeutic window for MARK2 inhibition in PAAD. Although the small molecule is potent and tractable (measured-potency-tractability potent_measured_ligand), MARK2 is broadly expressed across normal tissue (normal-tissue-liability-gtex broadly_expressed_normal; normal-tissue-liability broad_normal_expression) with HIGH_LIABILITY in single-cell normal cell types (sc-normal-celltype-expression HIGH_LIABILITY), and on-target toxicity is signaled by strong germline LoF constraint, lethal knockout, and germline-pathogenic variation (safety highly_constrained_safety_concern; gnomad-lof-constraint highly_constrained; mouse-ko-phenotype lethal_ko; clinvar-pathogenicity-safety germline_pathogenic). This yields essential_tissue_liability (modality-therapeutic-window essential_tissue_liability; modality-exon-window essential_exon_liability). The strong tumor-percentile enrichment (tumor-vs-normal-percentile-crossing strongly_tumor_enriched) does NOT rescue the window because normal-tissue liability is high and antigen-based sparing is unavailable (surface_modality neither_viable). A druggable-but-dangerous target.

proposed_verdict_reason.value: MARK2 in PAAD fails on the two decisive axes: no actionable dependency (non_dependent by CRISPR and RNAI, mechanistically explained by strong paralog buffering; the SL/combinatorial signal has no mapped partner in PAAD per partner-conditional-dependency no_partner_mapped) and no therapeutic window (highly_constrained_safety_concern from broad normal expression, highly constrained gnomad LoF, lethal KO, germline pathogenic, essential_tissue_liability). High chemical tractability (potent_measured_ligand, approved_drug_tractable, strong structure) makes the target druggable but not drug-worthy. The only enriched stratum (amplified/overexpressed-dependent) is not materially present given broadly_neutral copy number. Expect a deterministic safety gate to clamp regardless.

go_forth.next_evidence: Identify and functionally validate a PAAD-context actionable synthetic-lethal partner for MARK2 (a paired CRISPR/inhibitor combination screen in PAAD models querying the experimental SL partner from synthetic-lethal-partners against the paralog-buffering axis) — resolving whether the strong_synthetic_lethal signal can be operationalized (partner-conditional-dependency no_partner_mapped is the limiting gap). Even a positive result must be weighed against the unresolved safety liability; if no PAAD-actionable partner emerges, the target is confirmed dead in this indication.
go_forth.value_of_information: This directly resolves the principal tension (hollow SL/combination thesis with no mapped partner and no monotherapy dependency floor). A mapped, validated partner is the only path that could reopen a combination rationale; its absence confirms decline. It is more decision-changing than any window experiment because the dependency case must exist before safety trade-offs are even worth evaluating.
